scientific_integrity: Proof is a fully symbolic cycle-potential and descent argument. Finite searches n<=8 and direct edge-set searches n<=5 independently corroborate the theorem; they are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only matchings of cardinality n-1 in K_{n,n}, with legal adjacent-edge slides and n>=2. Not a result for arbitrary matching sizes, unrestricted jumps, vertex-token swaps, or other host graphs. Historical priority beyond inspected literature remains independently unverified.
title: An exact cycle-potential metric for sliding near-perfect bipartite matchings
